cohorts.selection: First legal single-vs-double position with next opponent 1 stone per deal/seat; select positive X>Y connector pair if present, smallest |gap|, else smallest negative |gap|. Greedy one-to-one same-profile negative-position controls by |gap|, connector class, focal hand size.
cohorts.limitations: Both actions legal only under provisional number locks. Positive vs negative control positions are observational and not causal; within each position arms change discarded tile, remaining double and branch state. Correlated worlds within positions, exploratory uncorrected cluster intervals, selected late positions, pass-conditioned uniform posterior omits action likelihood, unvalidated block winner/loneZero/bust/101-point match. Finish-first != match win.
cohorts.nextAction: Independent holdout and X/|gap|/connector stratification; authenticate real-table four-branch locking and block winner.
